data.name: Chiku
data.gender_notes: Chiku is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chiku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chik', meaning 'to be' or 'to exist'. It is often used as a term of endearment, signifying a blessing or fortune. The name Chiku carries the meaning “Blessing, Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chiku usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing, fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine presence and blessings
data.etymology: Chiku belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing, Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chiku total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
